prompt:
Goal: Create a clean anime character turnaround reference sheet for an elf maid girl, showing the same character consistently from multiple head angles for model-sheet use.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 canvas on a warm off-white paper background, lightly textured, with thin pale gray panel dividers. Arrange six evenly spaced bust portraits in a 3-column by 2-row grid.

Layout: Include exactly 6 labeled views: 1) FRONT (0°), 2) 3/4 LEFT (45°), 3) 3/4 RIGHT (45°), 4) LEFT (90°), 5) RIGHT (90°), 6) BACK (180°). Place each label centered beneath its portrait in small uppercase gray-black sans serif text. Keep all portraits cropped from upper chest to just above the hair accessories, consistent scale and alignment.

Subject details: The character is a young anime elf maid with pale skin, large red eyes, long pointed elf ears, and a calm slightly serious expression. She has light aqua blue short bob hair with straight bangs and soft layered ends, with the back view showing rounded bob volume and nape-length strands. Her outfit is a black-and-white gothic lolita maid uniform: black dress bodice, white ruffled shoulders and collar, black straps, small cross motifs, a black choker collar with a metal ring and red tag charm, and subtle silver ear piercings. Add a black-and-white frilled maid headband with black bows and a small red cross hair clip on the left side of her bangs.

Visual style: High-quality Japanese anime illustration, crisp clean line art, soft cel shading, delicate gradients in the hair, glossy highlights, detailed eyes, refined character-design-sheet rendering, neutral studio lighting, minimal background, professional reference sheet aesthetic.

Constraints: Preserve character identity across all 6 views, keep the same hairstyle, accessories, outfit, and proportions in every panel. Do not add extra views, full-body poses, speech bubbles, watermarks, logos, or decorative background elements.

promptZh:
目标：为 一位精灵女仆女孩 创建一张清晰的动漫角色三视图参考图，展示同一角色在多个头部角度下的一致性，供模型设计使用。

画布：16:9 宽幅横向画布，采用温暖的米白色纸张背景，带有轻微纹理，并配有浅灰色细分割线。将六张间距均匀的半身像按 3 列 2 行的网格排列。

布局：包含 6 个明确标注的视角：1) 正面 (0°)，2) 左侧 3/4 (45°)，3) 右侧 3/4 (45°)，4) 左侧 (90°)，5) 右侧 (90°)，6) 背面 (180°)。每个标签以小型大写灰黑色无衬线字体居中放置在肖像下方。所有肖像均从上胸部裁剪至发饰上方，保持比例和对齐方式一致。

主体细节：角色是一位年轻的动漫精灵女仆，皮肤白皙，红色大眼睛，长尖耳，表情冷静且略显严肃。她留着 浅水蓝色 短波波头，带有直刘海和柔软的层次感发梢，背面视图显示出圆润的波波头体积感和颈部长度的发丝。服装为黑白哥特萝莉女仆装：黑色连衣裙上衣、白色荷叶边肩部和领口、黑色肩带、小十字装饰、带有金属环和红色吊牌挂饰的黑色颈圈，以及精致的银色耳钉。在刘海左侧添加一个带有黑色蝴蝶结和红色小十字发夹的黑白荷叶边女仆头饰。

视觉风格：高质量日本动漫插画，线条清晰利落，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，头发带有细腻的渐变，光泽感高光，细节丰富的眼睛，精致的角色设计图渲染，中性摄影棚灯光，极简背景，专业的参考图美学。

约束条件：在所有 6 个视角中保持角色特征一致，确保每个面板中的发型、配饰、服装和比例完全相同。不要添加额外的视角、全身姿势、对话气泡、水印、Logo 或装饰性背景元素。
